digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI on mirror main branch
propositions: Cancelled GitHub Actions runs on main render as red X on healthy commits because per-commit concurrency cancels superseded runs.
Scheduled 6-hourly main-health runs replace push-triggered runs to test main's current state rather than every commit.
Last-known-green SHA is resolved from Actions API run history and published to workflow summary so bisect has a lower bound.
Failed runs emit copy-pasteable git bisect recipe with both bad and known-green SHAs to allow log(n)-step regression isolation.
Pre-merge Gerrit Verified gate is unaffected; the change alters only when safety-net CI runs, not what gates a merge.
Every workflow that ran on push to main is evaluated: three gain 6-hourly schedules, two drop push entirely, one keeps weekly cron unchanged.
